title: Checks for strings that include escaped quotes, and suggests changing the quote style to avoid the need to escape them.
summary: It's preferable to avoid escaped quotes in strings. By changing the outer quote style, you can avoid escaping inner quotes. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-quotes and made it stable in v0.0.88.
message_templates: Change outer quotes to avoid escaping inner quotes

title: Checks for strings that include unnecessarily escaped quotes.
summary: If a string contains an escaped quote that doesn't match the quote character used for the string, it's unnecessary and can be removed. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-quotes and made it stable in v0.2.0.
message_templates: Unnecessary escape on inner quote character
